stops.note: named the coca shrub whose leaves were chewed for stimulant effect
adopted by Spanish colonists in the Andes for the same plant
coined by chemist Albert Niemann, who isolated the alkaloid and added the scientific suffix '-ine'
stops.meaning: the stimulant alkaloid isolated from coca leaves

stops.note: adopted directly from the German scientific coinage
stops.meaning: an addictive stimulant drug derived from coca leaves

current_meaning: a powerful and addictive stimulant drug derived from the coca plant
